notes.title: Last game of the season.....
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

Thanks for playing Ripple Effect. We are going to be taking the next few months off and working on our next set of games. Please try our newest game, Arachnaphobia!

Try to defeat the huge spider monster with the abilities you learned in our other games. Use your spear to achieve victory!

Thanks for playing Ripple Effect. Look out for our next set of updates in the future.

WELL PLAYED STUDIOS

notes.title: A NEW WEEK.... A NEW GAME!!! PLAY "BAMBOO SLICE"!
notes.notes: Ever wanted to slice up ninjas in VR? Play our latest game “Bamboo Slice” and enjoy this new, exciting experience in “Ripple Effect”! Use your katana to stop an invading army of ninjas from attacking your village. It’s unlike anything you’ve ever experienced. Good luck!!

notes.title: Another Week Another New GAME!!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28991413/da84de863ab4cb4a159ddbd3de91bcea86429f3a.png[/img]We have another new game for you to try out. It's called Fire Blast.

You will have three different fire blasting abilities to use: Grenade, Shotgun, and the fire blaster. You're left hand will work as a grappling hook to destroy and grab your enemies. Try to defeat the flying eye monsters before they kill you.

notes.title: ANOTHER NEW GAME: "SHADOW KING"
notes.notes:
We have another new update for everyone. Please try our new game "Shadow King". It is our most difficult game yet and includes a number of different game play elements.

You must protect your lighthouses from the shadow king that is coming for you. Use your fanny pack and light discs to feed the energy console in the different rooms

notes.title: NEW GAME "GOBLIN SMASH"
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/soVV2a8.gif.gif[/img]

We have released a new game called Goblin Smash. Make sure to destroy the mounds and the goblin spawns. Watch out for the boss goblins!!!

Use teleport or the drive mechanic for this mini game. We recommend teleport if its your first time playing the game.

BUG FIXES:
Sky Roots
Tutorial audio fixes

Post any bugs or comments on our reddit or discord channels. Links in our discussion page

notes.title: NEW UPDATE AND GAME
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

We just released our first major update to the game. There is a new mini-game to try out "Asteroid Belt". Dodge the asteroids hurtling toward you! Use your four different powerups to last as long as possible.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/AEdhCT9.gif.gif[/img]

We love feedback from our users. Contact us at jason@wellplayedstudios.com if you have any questions.

BUG FIXES:
Added achievements
Fixed networking issues in mountain king
Made some changes to the tutorials

Best,
Well Played
